job.question: According to the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP, how many participants did the plan have and what were its total assets?
job.expected_facts: As of December 31, 2022: 4,398 plan participants and plan assets of $308,676,730. In addition, the OBRA part-time seasonal plan had 536 participants with assets of $926,785.
job.acceptance: Main plan 4,398 participants / $308,676,730 is sufficient. OBRA 536 / $926,785 is supplementary and must not replace or be silently added to main-plan figures.

reviews.reason: This is an Orange County Employees Retirement System custody-services RFP, not the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP. It does not state the requested main-plan participant count or asset total.
quotes: Custody Services Request for Proposal October 2022 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
There are approximately 49,000 members served by OCERS, of which over 20,000 are retirees.
The OCERS’ investment portfolio, approximately $22.4 billion in assets as of December 31, 2021, is diversified globally and across multiple asset classes.
